feed.title: Ebola Tracker: DR Congo
feed.subtitle: Independent, sourced tracker of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: confirmed cases and deaths, affected provinces, spread to other countries, vaccines, WHO risk and a dated timeline.

entry.title: CDC counts 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths in DR Congo
entry.summary: CDC's situation summary, updated 22 October with data as of 21 October, counts 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 confirmed deaths in DR Congo. Including Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France, it lists 9,735 confirmed cases and 4,690 confirmed deaths in total. CDC notes that counts may change as investigations continue and that DR Congo's health ministry does not include probable cases in its official reporting.
entry.content:
CDC's situation summary, updated 22 October with data as of 21 October, counts 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 confirmed deaths in DR Congo. Including Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France, it lists 9,735 confirmed cases and 4,690 confirmed deaths in total. CDC notes that counts may change as investigations continue and that DR Congo's health ministry does not include probable cases in its official reporting.

Sources: CDC: Ebola outbreak, current situation

entry.title: Africa CDC calls an extraordinary meeting of health ministers
entry.summary: Africa CDC said it will convene an extraordinary meeting of African health ministers on 28 October to strengthen the collective response to the outbreak, AP reported. Its director general said the outbreak demands urgent action and political leadership at the highest level.
entry.content:
Africa CDC said it will convene an extraordinary meeting of African health ministers on 28 October to strengthen the collective response to the outbreak, AP reported. Its director general said the outbreak demands urgent action and political leadership at the highest level.

Sources: AP via U.S. News, AP via Medical Xpress

entry.title: Kenya confirms a ninth Ebola case
entry.summary: Kenya's health ministry said one more person tested positive, bringing the total to nine including the first patient, who died. The new case is a contact of the first patient who was already in quarantine. The ministry said all nine cases belong to one cluster, that there is no evidence of transmission outside it, and that 134 of 135 identified contacts were in quarantine. It said the first group of contacts completes 21 days of quarantine on 25 October.

Sources: Al Jazeera, The Washington Post, The Standard (Kenya)

entry.title: Nigeria confirms an imported Ebola case
entry.summary: Nigeria's health ministry confirmed one case of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Federal Capital Territory, in a person with recent travel to Uganda; laboratory confirmation was on 20 October. Officials said 44 contacts had been identified. WHO calls it an imported case and the fifth country to detect the virus since the outbreak was declared, says where and when the person was exposed is not yet known, and advises against restrictions on travel or trade.

entry.title: DR Congo confirms Ebola in an eighth province, North Ubangi
entry.summary: DR Congo's health ministry said on 18 October that the outbreak has reached North Ubangi province, which borders the Central African Republic, with two cases, one of them fatal, in Wapinda health zone. Reuters and Bloomberg had reported the cases on 15 October before the official statement. AP reports the outbreak has recorded at least 9,400 confirmed cases and more than 4,500 deaths, with Ituri province accounting for almost three quarters of cases.
entry.content:

Sources: AP via U.S. News, AP via The Washington Times, Asharq Al-Awsat

entry.title: ECDC counts 9,455 cases and 4,561 deaths

It reports 66 of 178 health zones affected across eight provinces, and notes that DR Congo's figures are under continuous review and harmonisation, so they may change.

entry.title: Kenya confirms four more Ebola cases, total seven
entry.summary: Kenya's health ministry said four more people tested positive, bringing the total to seven including the first patient, who died. Three are health workers who cared for the first patient and one is a relative; all were already in quarantine. The ministry said 128 of 130 identified contacts were in quarantine, that there was no evidence of community transmission and that the risk to the general public remained low.

Sources: Al Jazeera, AP via The Washington Times, Bloomberg

entry.title: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case
entry.summary: Kenya's health ministry said a close contact of the first two patients, who had been in quarantine since 6 October, tested positive. The ministry said there was no evidence of community spread, and contacts continue daily monitoring for 21 days. Kenya now has three confirmed cases and one death.

entry.title: Media report Ebola in an eighth province, North Ubangi
entry.summary: Reuters and Bloomberg report, citing health officials, two confirmed Ebola cases in North Ubangi province, which borders the Central African Republic. Reuters says Congolese authorities had not yet officially announced the cases. It also reports that several suspected Ebola deaths had recently occurred at a mining site in Wapinda health zone, with samples sent for laboratory analysis in the province and in Kinshasa.

entry.title: ECDC: 9,277 cases and 4,478 deaths
entry.summary: ECDC reports 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 deaths in DR Congo as of 15 October (data to 14 October), with 924 patients in isolation in hospital. New cases in the latest report were in Ituri (31), North Kivu (28), Haut-Uele (5) and Tshopo (1). ECDC also notes the media reports of cases in North Ubangi.

entry.title: Kenya confirms a second Ebola case
entry.summary: Kenya's health ministry said a relative of the first patient, who was already in quarantine and under daily monitoring, tested positive after developing symptoms on 13 October. The ministry said it identified 128 contacts of the first patient and found no evidence of spread in the community. Kenya now has two confirmed cases and one death.

Sources: AP via WRAL, CBC, The Washington Post

entry.title: Africa CDC asks for accountability on over $700 million of response funding
entry.summary: Africa CDC's director general said on 14 October that more than $700 million of Ebola response funding channelled through international partners could not yet be traced to the response, and that the funds were not transferred to the DR Congo government. He asked partners to account for the money, and DR Congo authorities said they would ask the partners concerned for explanations.
entry.content:
Africa CDC's director general said on 14 October that more than $700 million of Ebola response funding channelled through international partners could not yet be traced to the response, and that the funds were not transferred to the DR Congo government. He asked partners to account for the money, and DR Congo authorities said they would ask the partners concerned for explanations.

Sources: Reuters via AOL, Africanews

entry.title: DR Congo reports 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths
entry.summary: DR Congo's health ministry reported 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths in its update of 13 October, according to Al Jazeera and Xinhua. Media reports describe it as the country's largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak. Ituri province accounts for most confirmed cases.
entry.content:
DR Congo's health ministry reported 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths in its update of 13 October, according to Al Jazeera and Xinhua. Media reports describe it as the country's largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak. Ituri province accounts for most confirmed cases.

Sources: Al Jazeera, Xinhua

entry.title: WHO experts: Tumaini vaccine trial expected by end of October
entry.summary: WHO experts said the Tumaini trial in DR Congo is expected to begin by the end of October. It will first test Ervebo, which is licensed for the Zaire strain, to see whether it protects against Bundibugyo virus. Candidates from Oxford and Moderna, now in early-phase trials, may be added later. Whether Ervebo protects against this strain is not yet known.

entry.title: Bundibugyo vaccine trial begins in Uganda
entry.summary: The MRC/UVRI & LSHTM Uganda Research Unit vaccinated the first participants in Masaka City with a candidate vaccine developed by the University of Oxford. The early-phase study tests safety and immune response in healthy adults and follows a trial of the same candidate in the UK. It does not yet show whether the vaccine protects against the virus.
entry.content:

Sources: MRC/UVRI & LSHTM Uganda Research Unit, Xinhua, The Independent (Uganda)

entry.summary: A Kenyan citizen living in DR Congo travelled by road to Kampala and flew to Nairobi on 3 October. He tested positive and died on 5 October. Contacts are being followed.

entry.title: Vaccination of health workers begins; Uganda declared Ebola-free
entry.summary: DR Congo starts giving Ervebo, a vaccine licensed for a different Ebola species, to health workers in trials. WHO and Africa CDC confirm the end of Uganda's outbreak after 42 days without cases.
entry.content:
